@untitled: the name shown for a page, file or item that has no title yet
@today: a date that is today (a due date, a heading for today's items)
@tomorrow: a date that is tomorrow (a due date, a heading)
@yesterday: a date that was yesterday (a due date, a heading)
@yes: the value of a ticked checkbox, written out as text
@no: the value of an unticked checkbox, written out as text
@loading: shown while something is being read
name: Name
@name: the name of a thing (a label above a name field)
@course: a school course or class (Biology, History), not a meal course
@tags: labels like #exam that people attach to pages, assignments and files
@notes: written notes (a label or heading for free text)

views.@home: the start screen: today's events, what's due, to-dos
views.@assignments: the view listing homework and other school assignments
views.@files: the file library: every file added to the app
views.@flashcards: the view of flashcard decks to study
views.@friends: the view of your friends, their requests and invites
views.@galaxy: the view that shows every page as a star and links between pages as lines, like a map of your notes
views.@trash: where deleted pages and items go before they're gone for good

actions.@add: button or menu command (a verb), same for the others in this group
actions.@cancel: button that closes a dialog without doing anything
actions.@clear: command that empties a field or removes a value
actions.@close: button that closes a window, panel or menu
actions.@done: button that finishes editing and closes (not a task status)
actions.@edit: command that opens something for editing
actions.@more: a button that opens a menu of more commands
actions.@new: button that creates a new item (a new row, page or card)
actions.@open: command that opens a page or file (a verb, not 'not closed')
actions.@remove: command that takes something out of a list (it isn't deleted)
actions.@restore: command that brings something back from the Trash
actions.@show: button that reveals or opens what a message is about
actions.@undo: button that reverses the last action (in a message after it)

units.@bytes: a file size under 1 KB; {size} is a number
units.@kilobytes: a file size in kilobytes; {size} is a number like 1.5
units.@megabytes: a file size in megabytes; {size} is a number like 1.5
units.@gigabytes: a file size in gigabytes; {size} is a number like 1.5
